notice: Development probes for the stage D reader. Synthetic, every person fictional. The 54 shared battery probes plus the probes from the four evaluation reports (Claude, GPT, Grok, Gemini had none of its own). They were written and adjudicated while the reader was built, so passing them shows the reader does what it was built to do. They are not a held-out measure. Notes say where an expectation was changed from the report that wrote it.
